turns.text: Nice, packing a deli sandwich is a great way to save time. Have you had any time to play your guitar lately, or has work been keeping you too busy?

turns.text: That's awesome. It's always nice when you get the place to yourself for some louder practice. What kind of stuff have you been working on?

turns.text: Mainly just some acoustic riffs and trying to learn a few new fingerpicking patterns. It's a nice way to unwind after looking at shipping spreadsheets all day.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Definitely a perfect creative outlet. Do you have any plans to head out climbing later this week, or are you taking a break for now?
